craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of workshop disputation — ends-first reasoning. Workshop hammer: without-potter double; how-could close. Rejected: (a) pot→jar → killed: pot is the example-term. Read aloud: WITH-out-THAT … HOW-COULD there-EV-en BE a-POT.

lines: how could there even be a pot?

reads_against.argmap: Without what no pot? → No pot without potter: how else could it be?
c1_essence: Potter necessary, nature watching, helpers insufficient, wisdom and will required, sufficiency tested (vv28-33).
Array excels by ends; Lord and un-Lord fenced off atomically; pradhāna will-less yet person-aim-ness stands (vv34-36).
